descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is one of many red-leaved forms in the Matsumurae Group. The leaves are deeply divided at least three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The points of the lobes radiate outward. The lobes are ovate and come to a sharp point. The edges show a marked, sharp, double serration. The medium-sized leaves are 6-7 cm long and wide and seem to extend laterally from the twigs in most growth and attempt to lie on the same plane. The coloration is a deep purplish red, hence the name which means "deep purple. " The color holds well in the summer heat. Along the center of the lobes, the color shades into a deep greenish red, thus making a contrast to the solid coloration. The fall foliage color is a strong crimson. descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是 Matsumurae Group 众多红叶类型之一。 叶片深裂，至少达叶基的四分之三处。 各裂片先端向外放射展开。 裂片呈卵形，先端锐尖。 叶缘具明显而锐利的重锯齿。 中等大小的叶片长宽约 6-7 厘米，在多数生长状态下似乎自枝条侧向伸展，并力求处于同一平面。 叶色为深紫红色，因此得名，意为“深紫”。 这种颜色在夏季高温中保持性良好。 裂片中央沿主脉处色泽会过渡为较深的带绿红色，从而与整体均一叶色形成对比。 秋叶为鲜明的深红色。 该品种耐寒，为小型乔木，冠幅与高度大致相当。 15 年或更久后，推测可达高、幅 3-4 米。 该品种也曾以 'Koi murasaki' 和
